result.title: Budgeted Bayesian Bandits for Future Utilization
result.summary: The multi-armed bandit problem models the trade-off between exploration and exploitation. In this paper, we study the variant where exploration has a hard budget and precedes exploitation. Prior guarantees include a 1/3 approximation by Guha and Munagala using Lagrangian duality, and a 4/27 approximation by Ma against a primal linear programming relaxation for a more general model. We show that the analyses of both algorithms are tight, even when their relaxations are asymptotically exact. We provide a different efficient algorithm that achieves a 0.43 approximation. We then provide an efficient algorithm whose guarantee approaches 1-e^{-1} approx 0.63 for bounded exchangeable reward observations in a non-vanishing regime, which is asymptotically tight against natural linear programming relaxations. The technique also gives certificates for stopping sequential model evaluation.

AI.brief_summary: 研究「先探索后利用、探索受硬预算约束」的多臂老虎机变体，证明已有 1/3 与 4/27 近似分析是紧的，并给出 0.43 近似的高效算法，以及在有界可交换奖励下逼近 1−1/e 的算法与紧性分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 latent 视觉推理无直接关联，但其「预算受限的探索—利用权衡」及「可为顺序模型评估提供停止证书」的结论，可能启发 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK 计算预算分配与证据获取的停止决策；这一迁移联系尚待核查。
